title: Log-Rank Conjecture in Communication Complexity
exact_target: Is deterministic communication complexity always bounded by a fixed power of the logarithm of the sign matrix's real rank?

sources.citation: S. Lovett, 'Communication is bounded by root of rank', arXiv:1306.1877, 2013; also in Proc. 29th IEEE Conf. on Computational Complexity (CCC), 2014.
